summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py gained Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk, four cells of indent per level, Measurement import added). rich/align.py gained Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with rendering (newline-segment padding from console.size.height), measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as unreleased with an Added subheading (two new entries) and keeps the existing markdown-over-STDIN entry above it. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, rendering, measurement, and no-attribute-error tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Not verified: I did not run the tests, per the instructions. The VerticalCenter rendering expectation ("

foo


" on a height-6 console) was derived by hand. Nothing was committed.
